findings.message: variable NGINX_TAG is not set and will be replaced by an empty string
findings.suggestion: Set NGINX_TAG in the project .env file or the shell environment. If empty is intended, write ${NGINX_TAG:-} to make it explicit.

findings.message: service "web" waits only for "cache" to start, not to be ready
findings.suggestion: Add a healthcheck to "cache" and use the long syntax `depends_on: {cache: {condition: service_healthy}}`, or make "web" retry its connection on start-up.
